text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Spe, Spe! I heard you're having trouble
with your
homework.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I aaaam! Why does math have to be so
hard...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Well, why didn't you say something
sooner? The
genius Teio will help you
study! ♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wow, really?! Well, then by all mea—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Wait, Teio... Aren't you a year
below me?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Am I? Well, I'm super smart, so it
doesn't
matter! ♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wow, thanks, Teio! Then please, share
your math
knowledge with me!
